title: ## SURVEY OF CRIME ## I.P.C. Crimes During the calendar year 1969, a total number of 8,45,167 Cognizable Crimes under the Indian Penal Code was reported in India showing a decrease of 2·0% over 1968. This figure includes crimes committed by Juveniles. The trend of crime during the sixties shows a rise till the year 1967 except for marginal decreases in 1963 and 1965 and a decrease thereafter.
